profile.headline: Software @ Tesla
profile.summary: Senior software engineer and former technical product manager at Tesla, specializing in distributed systems across the energy and solar   design domain. I own features end-to-end across 20+ microservices — from low-level engineering calculation libraries through domain APIs to   frontend components — and have built internal developer tooling that automates everything from incident triage to cross-service regression   testing. With a background leading the deployment of SolarAPP+ across 200+ jurisdictions and building business tools serving hundreds of   daily users, I bring both deep technical execution and a product-minded perspective to every system I touch.

positions.title: Sr Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Palo Alto, California, United States · On-site
positions.description:
- Architect and maintain microservices powering Tesla's solar design platform, routinely shipping coordinated changes across 3–5 repositories per feature   
 - Built a skill based agentic development harness that turns an AI coding assistant into a domain-aware engineering partner — automating issue triage through enterprise observability tools, QA environment access with secure M2M auth, API regression test generation, and release summary workflows, all orchestrated through composable skills that chain together autonomously
- Drive API development across the full stack — partner-facing endpoints, mobile backend services, imagery pipelines, and permitting integrations — with a strong emphasis on contract-first design and automated testing   
- Maintain high team velocity through active code review and cross-repo ownership spanning gateway, service, and library layers
- Leverage observability tooling and structured logging to diagnose production issues across distributed service boundaries, tracing failures through correlated request lifecycles

positions.title: Sr. Technical Product Manager
positions.description:
- Technical lead for SolarAPP+, an automated permitting platform used in over 200 jurisdictions across the United States.
- Responsible for the product road map and key architectural decisions towards the implementation of new features.
- Lead the implementation of multiple long term projects like the support of company products, a large database for structural calculations, and user acceptance testing by regulatory entities.

positions.title: Technical Product Manager
positions.description: Skills: Product Management · Startups · Electrical Engineering · Mechanical Engineering · Cross-functional Team Leadership

positions.title: Energy System Designer
positions.description:
- Developed a robust codebase in LISP for AutoCAD automation for almost 200 daily users. Empowering the design department with automation to increase quality and efficiency, supporting key products like the Tesla Inverter and Powerwall.
- Chrome Extension for internal web applications, implementing team tailored efficiency booster tools to assist in common repetitive tasks to reduce labor burden. Perceived efficiency gains of ~10\% per user.
- 2019 Q4 T.E.A.M. Award Nominee - Nominated to the individual on the Tesla Solar Design Department that embodies the principles of a leader through fostering others to grow and achieve success.

positions.title: Sr Technical Product Manager
positions.description: Helped Solarapp make instant permits a reality by taking it from an application with a single pilot permit in one jurisdiction, supporting a limited scope of residential solar installations, to a nationwide product utilized in hundreds of jurisdictions for complex residential solar and energy storage systems.

positions.title: Research Internship
positions.description: Canda MITACS scholarship for undergraduate researchers. Develoment of an application for the automation of 2D airfoil mesh generation, a common process in computational fluid dynamics analysis.

positions.title: Materials Engineering Research Assistant
positions.description:
Student part of the Institutional Training Program of Researchers of the National Polytechnic Institute of Mexico. Major contributions:

- Development of the tooling for the maintenance of the JT8D aircraft engine.
- Structural and metalographic analysis.
- Social work credits

positions.title: Mechanical Design Engineer
positions.description:
Joint project between the Mexican Air Force Research Center and the National Polytechnic Institute for a solid rocket design.  
- Mechanical design within a systems engineering framework.
- Use of CAD and CAE software for part design, aerodynamic and structural analysis.
- Metallographic and manufacturing processes analysis.

positions.title: Founder and Collaborator
positions.description:
Cuauhtémoc is a student team from the Aeronautical Engineering faculty of the National Polytechnic Institute contender in international aerospace competitions.

- Participation in the US CanSat Competition 2018 in which we designed, built and flew a satellite based on rigorous techincal requirements, achieving the overall 9th rank.

positions.title: Founding Leader
positions.description: 5th place from 81 teams from around the globe in the 2017 CanSat competition in Texas.

positions.title: Research Intern
positions.description: - Studied the behavior of Rare Earth Ceramics as thermal barriers for aircraft turbines in the National Lab of Thermal Projection of the Research and Advanced Studies Center of the National Polytechnic Institute (CINVESTAV).

company.name: Center for Advanced Research and Studies (CINVESTAV IPN)

positions.title: Summer Research Intern
positions.description: - Granted summer scholarship to participate in the study of fluid dynamics study to determine the stability of ships.

certifications.name: Applied Data Science I: Scientific Computing & Python (with honors)
certifications.title: Applied Data Science I: Scientific Computing & Python (with honors)

honors.title: 5th Mission Idea Contest Semi-Finalist - South American Seismic Sensing Constellation
honors.description:
Internationally renowned competition for nanosatellite concept missions. Our project involved the proposal a South American Seismic Sensing Constellation for timely earthquake detecion.

http://www.spacemic.net/

honors.title: CanSat Competition 9th Place
honors.description:
International competition of space probe a space probe development which involved receiving telemetry from sensors during a simulated mission of controlled and planed reentry through a planet's atmosphere using a mission deployed "heat shield" for aerodynamic drag assisted descent.

www.cansatcompetition.com

projects.title: Cuauhtémoc IPN Aeroespacial
projects.description: Estudiantes del Instituto Politécnico Nacional de Ingeniería Aeronáutica de la ESIME Ticoman. Jóvenes entusiastas y emprendedores con un gran interés en fomentar la innovación y el desarrollo en el área de ingeniería aeronáutica y aeroespacial en México y con la misión de difundir y demostrar que el alto nivel formativo y las competencias de los estudiantes mexicanos nos pone a la altura de las mejores Universidades del mundo.
